result.summary:
REQ-VALIDATOR verdict on REQ-001 (Pixel Office): FAIL. There are 5 blocking findings (B1-B5) and my sizing ruling (S1, split required). Eight minor findings (m1-m8) must be fixed in the same rework. Design must not start. Route back to REQ-ANALYST. Per S1, that handoff needs the right to add one new REQ id. Then re-validation.

Text validated: the REQ-001 block, lines 6-203. awk from '  - id: REQ-001' to the line before '  - id: REQ-002' gives sha256 c77fbfeda9c883f27c0709d563e66d0486d99405e32ca2c602dcef0fce512522. This equals the analyst's "after" value. I got the same hash at 17:10:18Z, 17:13:42Z and 17:27:50Z. Only the REQ-006 part of the file changed meanwhile (whole file 0f37a040... -> 2352fc0a... -> b5e18600...).

WHAT PASSES
- Fidelity. I parsed the YAML (ruby Psych) and normalised whitespace. All six quotes in original_request are verbatim. The four owner quotes and their date phrases («(в сессии Claude Code, между 2026-09-25 и 2026-09-28; точная дата не записана)», 2026-09-25, 2026-09-30) are in decisions/0003, «Поручения владельца, дословно». The two osnova sentences are in reference/pixel-office-osnova/docs/REQ-OSN-003-agent-office.md, «Исходный запрос», which introduces them as «ограничения владельца». Nothing else is attributed to the owner, and the numbers are marked as the analyst's. Limitation: I could not compare against the pre-rewrite REQ-001 text. sai/ is untracked in git. grep over <общая папка> finds the quotes only in requirements.yaml, decisions/0003 and the osnova files. Reading the session transcripts was denied by the permission classifier, and I did not retry. So fidelity rests on the primary sources.
- Hook facts (1)-(9). I opened the docs myself, and each claim matches the current text. All 14 sections REQ-001 names exist.
  (1) «Hook lifecycle» lists the 8 events. «PreToolUse input» → «Agent» has prompt, description and subagent_type (and model).
  (2) «Common input fields» has no event-time field. A search of the whole page finds only timeouts, duration_ms and SessionStart's seconds_since_last_response, which is a duration.
  (3) UserPromptSubmit carries prompt; Stop and SubagentStop carry last_assistant_message.
  (4) SubagentStart fires «when Claude resumes a subagent». SubagentStop also fires for internal agents, with the session's agent_type or "". Stop «Does not run if the stoppage occurred due to a user interrupt. API errors fire StopFailure instead».
  (5) «Other exit codes»: empty or plain stdout gives a «<hook name> hook error» notice. «Exit code 0»: plain stdout of UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, SessionStart and PostModelSwitch goes into Claude's context.
  (6) The timeout default is 600 for command/http/mcp_tool and 30 on UserPromptSubmit. An HTTP «Connection failure» is a non-blocking error. -p kills async hooks at teardown.
  (7) settings: «reads the shared .claude/settings.json from the session's primary working directory, so to use a file committed at the repository root, start Claude Code there». /cd works from v2.1.246.
  (8) «Workspace trust»: interactive sessions hold hooks back until the folder is trusted; -p treats the folder as trusted.
  (9) «As of v2.1.198, subagents run in the background by default», giving async_launched.
  Left open correctly: the agentId link (the docs' examples even use different formats, agent-abc123 and a4d2c8f1e0b3a297), handler type and async, and Node in the hook environment. The output format for AC1(ж) is also open correctly: cli-reference has --include-hook-events, which needs --output-format stream-json.
- Environment facts confirmed: <каталог Homebrew> is v25.2.1; <каталог Homebrew> is v22.21.1; command -v claude prints nothing; extension anthropic.claude-code-2.1.284 is installed; .claude/agents/ has 23 roles. TZ=Asia/Almaty turns 2026-09-20T04:00:00Z into 09:00, labelled Asia/Almaty, on Node 22 and on Node 25. /etc/localtime is Asia/Almaty. ~/.claude/projects has only -Users-whooch-solution-platform, which confirms the analyst's question 1 (already ruled by ORCH).
- Consistency. depends_on [REQ-002] is right (REQ-002 is done). decisions/0002 is reflected: Node 22, no runtime dependencies, one check. decisions/0003 is reflected: not product code, localhost only, secret outside the repo. AP-002 is addressed in intent: no seed file, hook time, REAL mark. The not-applicable reasoning for Q8, R3, Q9 and Q11 is right. I found no wording that lowers the bar.
- Security coverage is present:
  - AC11: 127.0.0.1 only, Host check, no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, no external loads.
  - AC13: secret file 0600 in a 0700 folder outside the repo, never printed, grep sweep.
  - AC10: one write route behind the secret, the page sends only GET, escaping, CSP.
  - AC3: allowlist of stored fields. AC12: fast, silent hook.
- The named commands run (dry runs listed below).

BLOCKING
B1 - AC14 and description «Где что лежит» (0003 boundary). The check misses the settings file Claude Code actually uses. The settings page, «Where Claude Code keeps the local file in a git repository», says: «If you start Claude Code in a subdirectory of a git repository, it reads and writes that file at the repository root». A copy in the starting directory is read only as a legacy file. sai/ has no .git; `git -C sai rev-parse --show-toplevel` gives <общая папка>, owned by the user. So for sessions started in sai/, the local file is <общая папка>/.claude/settings.local.json. AC14 does not check it. It also does not check <общая папка>/.claude/settings.json or platform/.claude/settings*.json, where the pipeline session actually runs. Those are exactly the places someone would add hooks to make the pipeline visible. A handler there passes AC14 and breaks the boundary. Fix: state this fact, citing that docs section. Replace the two greps with a sweep: `find ~/.claude <общая папка> -name node_modules -prune -o -path '*/.claude/settings*.json' -print | xargs grep -l pixel-office` must print exactly <папка Sai>/.claude/settings.json (UAT step and RELEASE-VALIDATOR). I dry-ran it: it runs in under a second and matches nothing today.

B2 - description «Параллельная работа», AC9 and AC15, versus ORCH ruling 5. REQ-001 puts code in tools/src/pixel-office/ and tests in tools/test/pixel-office-*.test.js, and requires tools/README.md. ORCH's declared list names tools/pixel-office/ and tools/test/pixel-office/, leaves out tools/README.md, and says the design must stay within it. tools/src/snapshot.js allows a folder only when the value ends in "/"; any other value allows one exact file. So every REQ-001 file would be an unexpected «added» line in REQ-006 AC14. The only alternative is a design that breaks REQ-001's named paths. Fix: REQ-001 lists its full write set: tools/src/pixel-office/; the tests either in tools/test/pixel-office/ (with the file names in AC2-AC14 changed) or named one by one; tools/README.md; tools/package.json; tools/eslint.config.js (browser globals for public/, which eslint needs because only globals.node is set today); .claude/settings.json. ORCH then declares exactly that set.

B3 - description «Где что лежит», AC2 and AC4 (R2, AP-002). The claim «так что дописать событие задним числом нельзя» is false. The ±60 s check guards only the HTTP route. Any process running as the owner, which includes every agent, can append a back-dated line with "source":"REAL" straight into ~/.sai-pixel-office/events.jsonl. The page would show it as real, which is the AP-002 failure. No criterion covers a direct file append. Fix: correct the sentence to say the mandate is the only guard against direct writes. Add a read-side rule to AC4 with a test: a line whose time is more than 60 s earlier than the latest time among the lines before it is shown with «не из хуков». It is not used for tasks, states or moves. Real lines are appended in arrival order within the ±60 s window, so they never trip it. Test: pixel-office-server/page tests with a hand-appended back-dated REAL line.

B4 - AC3 versus AC6 and AC7 (R2). The allowlist removes the only documented link between an Agent call and its run. Per the docs, description and subagent_type are in tool_input of the Agent call (PreToolUse/PostToolUse). SubagentStart and SubagentStop carry only agent_id and agent_type. The only documented bridge is tool_response.agentId in PostToolUse, «Identifier for the subagent run». AC3 forbids tool_response and does not list tool_input.subagent_type. Meanwhile AC6 makes the description part of every task and leaves the linking to the design. WF-06 runs three IDEA-ANALYST runs of the same agent_type in parallel. Linking by order can then put a description on the wrong run: an untrue display with no criterion or test. Fix, either:
  (a) add these two non-content identifiers to AC3's allowlist and adjust the marker test; or
  (b) add AC6 rule (з): when identifiers cannot tie the description to the run, the task shows no description, never a guessed one. Test: two starts of the same type after two Agent calls with different descriptions.
AC7's launcher rule already has the right fallback («перемещения нет»).

B5 - AC12 (Q10). Realistic hook-environment failures are missing. The docs say:
  - «Hook handler fields»: «Handlers run in the current directory»; «Reference scripts by path»: cwd follows Claude after `cd`.
  - «Other exit codes»: a hook that cannot start produces the visible «Failed with non-blocking status code» notice.
  - «UserPromptSubmit»: a hook that reaches its timeout also leaves a notice in the transcript.
The main session changes its cwd routinely (`cd tools && npm run check`), and the owner's default node is v25.2.1. Yet AC12's test does not set the cwd, covers «нет Node 22» only as «PATH без node», and its jq bounds the timeout only from above. Fix: add these cases:
  - the handler command run with cwd sai/tools and with a temp folder outside sai/: the event is still recorded, exit 0, empty stdout, 2 s at most;
  - a PATH whose only node is not v22.
Bound the timeout to 3 <= timeout <= 5, so Claude Code never cancels the hook before its own 2 s limit.

SIZING - S1 (analyst's question 6, which ORCH left to me): split REQ-001 in two. It bundles two separately verifiable deliverables:
  (a) the truthful event pipeline with the task view: hook, server, journal, secret, settings, task list, journal, live update. This answers «смотрел задачи какие выполняют».
  (b) the office: canvas grid, desks, characters, movement, agent card. This answers «не теряй pixel office» and «смотреть на агентов».
There are 16 criteria, several with 6-8 sub-rules; the page alone is more than one FRONTEND-DEV turn. The split also gets the uncertain hook work validated before the office is built on it.
Proposed split:
  - REQ-001 keeps AC1-AC6 and AC9-AC16 (AC5 without the agent card, AC4 without the movement clause).
  - A new REQ (depends_on [REQ-001]) takes AC7, AC8, the agent card from AC5 and the movement clause of AC4. AC10's page rules and AC11 apply to its files with the same tests. It carries the same verbatim original_request.
ORCH declares the new REQ's paths too.

MINOR (fix in the same rework)
m1 AC2 and AC11: «grep ... — пусто» also passes when the folder is missing (grep exits 2 with empty stdout; checked with ugrep and BSD grep). Fix: require exit code 1.
m2 AC16: the Q6 greps look only for the strings «pixel-office» and «ignores». A .prettierignore line such as `src/**/public/` or `*.html` would pass. So would an in-file `/* eslint-disable */` or `// prettier-ignore`, or `{ skip: true }`, t.skip() or todo in the new tests. Fix: tools/.prettierignore sha256 unchanged (today it holds node_modules and package-lock.json). `grep -rnE 'eslint-disable|prettier-ignore'` and a skip/todo grep over the new files must exit 1.
m3 AC4: the header label «REAL — события хуков Claude Code» has no named check. Fix: add it to pixel-office-page.test.js.
m4 AC7: «при нескольких идущих сессиях» is undefined. Fix: define it, e.g. a session_id with an event after the last server start and no session-end event.
m5 AC6(г): the Stop section says a session can be «paused waiting for background work to wake it back up». Background subagents are the default, and whether a woken turn fires UserPromptSubmit is not documented. There is no rule for an end-of-turn event with no open row. Fix: add it to the design questions, plus a rule that such an event changes nothing (a start is never invented).
m6 description «Сбои»: «Потерянное событие не становится неправдой» claims too much. Suppose an end event is lost while the server stays up, in a session that keeps running or is killed without SessionEnd. The task stays «в работе» until the next server start. Fix: state this remaining case, in the requirement and in the README. Optionally show the time of the last event next to «в работе».
m7 design question «тип обработчика (command или http)»: AC12 (exit code and stdout of «команда обработчика») and AC13 («хук читает секрет из файла») already require a command handler. The docs also say SessionStart accepts only command and mcp_tool handlers. An http handler can get a header secret only from environment variables. Fix: state that the handler is a command, with these reasons, or make AC12 and AC13 handler-neutral.
m8 AC10 (Q10): the server's own write failure (journal not writable, disk full) is not covered. Fix: answer 500, keep serving GET; test with a read-only temp journal.
Note, not a finding: GET has no login, so any local OS account can read the journal through 127.0.0.1, even though the files are 0700/0600. This is acceptable (the 0003 boundary is met and the data is minimised), but tools/README.md should say so.
